rules_root: Use py for Python commands in this repository.
The SQLite database is the canonical data source for analysis; no direct FastF1 access from analysis, model, adapter, scorer, or predictor code.
Prefer one clear execution path over compatibility shims or dual-format boundary acceptance.
Validate public and meaningful internal inputs with failure messages naming field, expectation, and actual value.
Use test-led changes where a test surface exists; run focused region tests before and after touching source.
Time-dependent prediction inputs require explicit as-of cutoffs; no silent latest-value fallback.
Represent missingness intentionally with named/configured policy; do not guess, zero, or inline-impute silently.
Evo/probability changes require calibrated baseline evidence when behavior quality changes; Brier is primary for gold comparison.
Physics model changes require highest-applicable L1-L4 truth evidence with units, bounds, and invariants explicit.
Committed report schema changes update producers, committed consumers, and docs/report_schemas documentation together.
Generated artifacts are derived; edit sources/configuration or regenerate rather than manually editing run outputs.
Mutable module-level runtime state, impure caches, and module-level DatabaseManager singletons are review blockers in src/.
Commit non-context .agent-work/templates workflow templates; docs/agents is the durable context source.
Commit Commander work logs only after the work package is finished and archived under .agent-work/archive.
Keep documentation current when contracts, ownership, data flow, commands, or failure meaning change.
Track any project-tenet compromise with reason, exit condition, and owner.
